commit.subject: LU-15842 tests: check_fhandle_syscalls prints deltas
commit.message:
LU-15842 tests: check_fhandle_syscalls prints deltas

In lustre/tests/check_fhandle_syscalls.c print the name and values of
the mismatched attributes.  This allows debugging sanityn.sh test_102
errors more easily.

Test-Parameters: trivial testlist=sanityn env=ONLY=102,ONLY_REPEAT=100 fstype=zfs mdtcount=2
